title: Troisième contribution déterminée au niveau national (CDN 3.0)
temporal_coverage: National climate and disaster context, including 2018–2023 events and adaptation priorities
methodology: Nationally determined contribution describing climate context, vulnerability, reported disaster impacts and planned adaptation priorities.
limitations: French-language national plan; adaptation priorities and risk tables are not independent impact evaluations. Historical event figures are reported by the NDC.

title: Initial National Communication on Climate Change: Executive Summary
organization: Government of the Union of the Comoros, Ministry of Development, Infrastructures, Post and Telecommunications and International Transports, General Directorate of Environment
temporal_coverage: Initial national communication and projections through 2050, published in 2002; some farming-system data date to 1987
methodology: Executive summary drawing on vulnerability studies for agriculture, coastal infrastructure and resources, health and water, with IPCC-based island projections.
limitations: Historical assessment with old demographic and land-use inputs; projections reflect the science and assumptions available in 2002.

title: Comoros country overview
temporal_coverage: Current World Bank country-page overview; publication date not stated
methodology: World Bank country overview page; no underlying analysis method is stated on the inspected passage.
limitations: Undated, mutable summary page; the inspected passage gives no detailed measurement method for infrastructure vulnerability.

title: Analyse du paysage climatique pour les enfants aux Comores
geographic_coverage: coastal and riverine areas across the islands
temporal_coverage: Observed island-level water access; modeled rainfall and sea-level risks to 2090; May 2024 flood impacts.
methodology: UNICEF climate-landscape assessment using secondary evidence and youth consultations.
limitations: National assessment with limited local exposure and displacement estimates.

title: Comoros National Water Resilience Project (P504691) – Additional Financing Request 1
temporal_coverage: Project appraisal context and water-sector conditions documented in April 2025.
methodology: Public-disclosure appraisal-stage project information document with country and water-sector context.
limitations: Project document summarizing sector estimates; it is not an independent national water-sector evaluation.

title: Inondation en mai- juin 2024 : Une main forte extraordinaire dans les zones sinistrées
temporal_coverage: May 2024 floods and response measures reported through September 2024.
methodology: UNDP article reporting official flood response, affected localities and follow-up works.
limitations: News report, not a comprehensive damage assessment or independent response evaluation.

title: Increased Access to Water Supply for Resilience in Comoros (IAWASuR)
temporal_coverage: Project status milestones through August 2025 and planned cross-island water-resilience activities.
methodology: Official project summary, intended beneficiaries, expected outcomes and approval milestones.
limitations: The page describes aims and expected outcomes, not verified implementation results.
